title: Christoph Scheuch
text:
Christoph Scheuch
Financial economist · Reproducible research · Data workflows

I’m an Associate Researcher at Humboldt University of Berlin, an Open Science Ambassador of the Berlin University Alliance, and a Data Editor at the Review of Financial Studies.
I co-created the open-source projects Tidy Finance and EconDataverse to foster reproducible research in finance and economics.
Through Tidy Intelligence, I audit and improve data workflows. I also offer trainings in the practices that keep results trustworthy.
